sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A15 = (
    SELECT A15 
    FROM district 
    ORDER BY A15 DESC 
    LIMIT 1, 1
)
